methods.description: Identify the operations on the subject and undo them on both sides; divide by complete products, keep whole numerators together and undo bracket operations in reverse order.
When the subject is in the denominator, multiply both sides by it, then divide to isolate the subject.
Isolate the square or cube, then take the matching root; include both signs for an unrestricted squared subject and respect a stated positive restriction.
Isolate a square root, square both sides, then apply remaining inverse operations to isolate the subject.
